name: Buildertrend
summary: Construction management for home builders and remodelers with scheduling, selections, client portal, estimating and bid requests.
differentiator: Estimating, takeoff and bid requests are reported not to start until the middle Advanced plan, so the real entry price for bidding is that tier. Sources disagree on the figure: $499 per month billed annually against $799 billed monthly. All plans include unlimited users, and onboarding is reported at $500 to $2,000 extra in year one.
pricing: Third-party sources report Essential, Advanced and Complete at $339, $499 and $829 per month billed annually, or $499, $799 and $1,099 billed monthly. The estimating suite is reported to start at Advanced. Onboarding is reported at $500 to $2,000. The vendor pricing page returned an error when checked.
whoPays: Subscriber pays per plan; unlimited users
entryPrice: Bidding starts at Advanced, reported $499 to $799 per month
bestFor: Established residential builders who want one system for the whole job.
skipIf: You mainly need bid comparison for a small team and cannot justify a four-figure monthly plan.
